lead QBRs, mission reviews, and strategic planning Define success metrics and capture baselines before major deployments so impact is proven, not assumed Field Intelligence & Growth Capture customer insights, workflow patterns, and adoption barriers; share field intelligence with Product and Engineering to influence roadmap decisions Turn one-off builds into reusable playbooks and operational frameworks Identify expansion opportunities based on demonstrated impact; partner with Sales on long-term account strategy Onsite Engagement & Outcomes Maintain consistent onsite presence (approximately 3-4 days/week), closely connected to agency operations and evolving needs Track customer success metrics: time-to-first-production-use, adoption depth by role and site, workflow improvements, and mission outcomes Support Sales → Post-Sales onboarding and handoff, establishing goals and accountability from day one What You Bring Required Experience in customer-facing technical roles, program management, operational transformation, or complex deployment environments (typically 8+ years; review_candidates.description: Job Description BAE Systems is seeking Engineering Manager to support our work as a prime contractor on a high-profile U.S. Navy weapon system. The ideal candidate will be someone who can lead a team of five to seven engineers toward meeting a set of objectives, demonstrate the behaviors to effectively communicate, coordinate, collaborate, and work in a visible and proactive manner across organizational boundaries to deliver positive results. This role is fit for someone who can be a highly engaging, team-oriented, problem solving, and self-starting individual able to respond rapidly to a dynamic programmatic environment. Responsibilities As the Test Development Engineering Manager for the System Test program area, your responsibilities span engineering management, personnel management, and customer relationship management including: Engineering Management Manage execution of engineering capabilities (people, process, tools) and work products (deliverables) in the areas of systems test policy and process definition. Ensure the timely development of system test products to support issuance of contract deliverables. Support System Test activities across the engineering lifecycle, for a complex systems-of-systems, including the mapping of requirements to system attributes and interfaces. Identify System Test assessment characteristics that can be gathered from component level development testing activities for use in system level integration assessments. Support the test team in the execution of compatibility and interoperability assessments to ensure the entire system will have the form, fit, and function to execute the intended mission(s). Support Test leadership in the development of presentations and materials to support technical meetings and program reviews. Attending meetings, as necessary, to support tasks above. Some meetings may occur offsite, requiring local travel to Washington, DC or subsystem development/testing facilities. Applying Modeling-based Systems Engineering tools to develop digital engineering products Personnel Management Functional management over a five-to-seven-person team to include performance and development objective setting, conduct of semi-annual performance reviews, personnel development and training, annual salary planning, and hiring/onboarding of new personnel. Assemble, lead, and manage high-performance teams focused on delivering engineering products and developing innovative solutions to complex mission and business challenges. Customer Relationship Management Establish and maintain exceptional relationships with GS-14/15 level US Navy customers/clients to solve technical problems and implement solutions of high complexity. About BAE Systems and the U.S. Navy’s (USN’s) Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) Strategic Systems Programs (SSP) Our organization has supported the USN’s PAE SSP continually since the command’s inception in the 1950s. PAE SSP developed the first sea-based, underwater-launched Strategic Weapons System (SWS), a defense system that is critical to our national security. PAE SSP has maintained and upgraded the sea-based SWS for more than six decades, and we have been there every step of the way: it is the ultimate stealthy weapons system, and is one leg of the U.S. nuclear triad. Containing over 70% of our nation’s nuclear arsenal, its importance to maintaining world peace cannot be overstated. Development of the Columbia-class submarine—the most advanced nuclear-powered, nuclear-armed submarine ever designed—and the D5LE2 system are underway, and rollout will begin within the next decade. The USN projects this system to be operational through 2084, meaning the program will have a total life span of more than 120 years. This is a truly unique program, and the BAE Systems employees who support it understand that they’re part of an important legacy. As a decades-long sole-source partner on multiple contracts on behalf of our customer, our program has remarkable stability and is concurrently experiencing significant growth. These factors combine to provide ample opportunity for professional growth and development for capable and talented individuals on our team. BAE Systems, Inc. is a wholly owned U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, which provides some of the world's most advanced, technology-led defense, aerospace, and security solutions. As one of the top ten defense contractors, we employ a skilled workforce of around 100,000 people in more than 40 countries. We develop, engineer, manufacture, and support products and systems to protect national security and keep people safe. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience. Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference. Our pride and dedication shows in everything we do—from intelligence analysis, cyber operations and IT expertise to systems development, systems integration, and operations and maintenance services. Knowing that our work enables the U.S. military and government to recognize, manage and defeat threats inspires us to push ourselves and our technologies to new levels. Contribuir al seguimiento de indicadores de servicio. 4. Infraestructura y soporte de equipos Realizar ensamble, instalación, configuración y puesta en operación de equipos de cómputo. Ejecutar actualizaciones, optimizaciones y pruebas funcionales antes de la entrega. 5. Registrar evidencias fotográficas o digitales cuando corresponda. Apoyar procesos de reasignación, traslado y devolución de activos. Garantizar la trazabilidad de los equipos intervenidos. 6. Documentación técnica y control Registrar de manera clara y oportuna las actividades ejecutadas. Elaborar informes técnicos y diagnósticos. Ambientes con acuerdos de niveles de servicio – SLA. 🌟 FACTORES DIFERENCIADORES Y SALARIALES La Compañía podrá reconocer un nivel salarial superior de acuerdo con la formación, experiencia y competencias demostrables del candidato. Iniciativa para identificar oportunidades de mejora. Disposición para aprender y asumir nuevos retos. CONDICIONES LABORALES Contrato: Término indefinido.
